subject: english
prompt: 在2024年12月2日校園圖書館週末課堂活動中，在「英語文學習重點」能力練習中，Which sentence best summarizes this message: 'Please bring a reusable bottle on Friday.'？

options.text: Students should bring a new desk on Monday.
The bottle is not allowed on Friday.
The message is about a school holiday.
Students should bring a reusable bottle on Friday.

answer.explanation: The summary keeps the item and the day stated in the message. 本題對應 KG「英語文學習重點」，情境為2024年12月2日校園圖書館週末。
